title: Mailbox for Laravel: Preview and Test Rendered Email
content:
Mailbox for Laravel captures outgoing mail in a local dashboard and lets you test rendered HTML, recipients, and attachments with fluent assertions.

The post Mailbox for Laravel: Preview and Test Rendered Email appeared first on Laravel News.
